Reranking with return_documents flag to include document text

```rust title="Rust"
use liter_llm::BatchClient;
use liter_llm::FileClient;
use liter_llm::LlmClient;
use liter_llm::ResponseClient;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let request_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"documents":["Rust is a systems programming language.","Iron rusts when exposed to water."],"model":"rerank-v3.5","query":"What is Rust?","return_documents":true}"#).unwrap();
    let request = serde_json::from_value(request_json).unwrap();
    let client = liter_llm::create_client(std::env::var("API_KEY").expect("API_KEY must be set"), None, None, None, None).unwrap();
    let result = client.rerank(request).await;
    println!("{:?}", result);
}
```
